title: Koko Eating Bananas
statement: Koko eats all bananas from one pile before starting another, at a constant integer speed of k bananas per hour. Each pile takes ceil(pile / k) hours. Return the minimum k that finishes every pile within `h` hours.
hints: Hours needed is monotone in the speed: a faster speed never takes more hours.
The search range is 1..max(piles). At max(piles), every pile takes one hour.
Binary search the smallest speed whose hour count is at most h.
editorial: This is binary search on the answer, not on an array index. The predicate 'speed k finishes in at most h hours' is false, then true, as k grows. Compute hours with integer ceiling division (pile + k - 1) // k and shrink to the first true speed.
